sources.title: llama-tinker-lora-news-enhancer-v2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This project presents a comprehensive evaluation of LoRA fine-tuning approaches for enhancing AI-related news content with rich semantic metadata. Using meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B as the base model, we compare three approaches across 460 hand-annotated examples split 80/20 for training and evaluation.

sources.title: Truthseeker87/llama-tinker-lora-news-enhancer · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a personal project addressing my need around news analysis of the fast-moving AI industry. I collect AI-related news content from various sources and needed a way to enhance raw news content with rich semantic metadata. This enables deeper, structured analysis and pattern-finding across trends and developments in the AI industry.

sources.snippet: We propose LLaMA-LoRA, a neural prompt engineering framework that builds upon the LLaMA-13B model and incorporates the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) of Large Language Models technique for refinement.
